title: Managing Performance: Setting KPIs, Tracking Progress and Providing Feedback
overview: Effective performance management is a continuous management process that connects organizational priorities with individual contribution, establishes clear expectations, measures meaningful results, supports employee development, and addresses performance gaps before they become persistent problems.

This five-day course provides managers and HR professionals with a practical framework for setting performance objectives, developing relevant KPIs, establishing targets, tracking progress, conducting performance conversations, providing constructive feedback, coaching employees, managing underperformance, and carrying out fair performance reviews.

The program emphasizes performance management as an ongoing cycle rather than an annual appraisal event. Through KPI design exercises, performance cases, feedback simulations, coaching practice, calibration discussions, and action planning, participants learn how to create greater clarity, accountability, fairness, and improvement in employee performance.
audience: Managers, supervisors, team leaders, department heads, HR managers and specialists, HR business partners, performance-management professionals, talent-management professionals, and employees responsible for setting objectives, measuring performance, providing feedback, coaching employees, or conducting performance reviews.
methodology: The course uses an applied methodology combining short presentations, performance-management cases, objective-setting workshops, KPI design exercises, target-setting activities, dashboard and progress-review exercises, feedback role plays, coaching simulations, difficult performance conversations, rating and calibration cases, group discussion, and individual action planning.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Explain the complete performance-management cycle and the responsibilities of managers and employees.
Translate organizational and departmental priorities into meaningful individual performance objectives.
Develop relevant KPIs that measure results rather than activity alone.
Set clear baselines, targets, thresholds, and measurement responsibilities.
Track performance consistently using appropriate evidence and review routines.
Diagnose performance gaps and distinguish capability, motivation, clarity, and resource issues.
Provide timely, specific, balanced, and actionable feedback.
Use coaching techniques to improve employee capability and ownership.
Conduct effective progress reviews and difficult performance conversations.
Manage underperformance using clear expectations, support, documentation, and follow-up.
Conduct fair performance appraisals and reduce common rating biases.
Develop a practical approach for improving performance management within their teams.
